author: smcarus
title: Reproduce the Bohn fiscal reaction estimate for Brazil
summary: Country Research > History & data shows a Bohn fiscal reaction estimate: how the primary balance responds to last year's debt. Reproduce the app's coefficient for Brazil in R, Python or Stata from the same IMF series, and explain any difference.
target: Brazil, Bohn fiscal reaction panel: the coefficient on lagged debt, with the sample years and settings the panel states.
knownLimits: The IMF revises its history each WEO edition; use the vintage the app states and say which you used.
A script that shows the app is wrong also solves the Quest.
